newsitem.title: USA: Harnischfeger may drop bid for Giddings.
newsitem.headline: Harnischfeger may drop bid for Giddings.

text.p: Harnischfeger Industries Inc said Thursday it may drop its $19 a share hostile bid for Giddings & Lewis Inc in light of a competiting bid for Giddings from Thyssen AG of Germany.
"If Thyssen's bid for $21 per share proves bona fide to us, we will not pursue our tender offer for G&L," Harnischfeger Chairman Jeffery Grade said in a statement.
He added the company is already examining other options.
Earlier today, Giddings agreed to be acquire by Thyssen for $21 a share in a transaction valued at about $700 million.

"Harnischfeger has many alternatives to develop its Industrial Products & Services strategy," Grade said. "Additionallly, there are many opportunities available that will enable us to continue building our global businesses."
Harnischfeger makes and distributes equipment for underground mining, surface mining, pulp and papermaking, and materials handling.
